hero.lede: Most space templates are one page with a rotating globe. ORBIT is a working platform — a live-style dashboard, an interactive sky map, real satellite tracking visuals, and a data center with sortable tables. Built once, reusable for news sites, science education, or a space startup's homepage.

features.title: Not a landing page. A platform.
features.subtitle: Every feature below is real and working in the live demo — not a screenshot mockup.

f1.title: Real Three.js 3D Earth
f1.body: Procedural shader-based continents, an atmosphere glow, orbital rings, and satellites that actually move — not a static image.

f2.title: Live Mission Dashboard
f2.body: A full "mission control" style dashboard with a mini Earth widget, live charts, and animated counters — the page a real product would ship.

f3.title: Interactive Sky Map
f3.body: A Canvas-based night sky with a real time slider — drag ±12 hours and watch stars and planets shift, no plugin required.

f4.title: Full Arabic RTL Support
f4.body: Not a machine-translated afterthought — the layout, icons, forms, and even chart labels mirror correctly in Arabic.

f5.title: Clean, Modular Code
f5.body: CSS split into base/components/layouts. JavaScript split by feature. No framework, no build step — open it and read it.

f6.title: Offline-Ready
f6.body: A service worker caches every page and script on first visit, so the demo (and your version of it) keeps working with no connection.

faq.title: Before you buy
faq.q1: Do I need to know Three.js to customize it?
faq.a1: No. The 3D scene works out of the box — you only need to touch the Three.js files if you want to change the Earth's look or add new objects. Everything else is plain HTML/CSS.
faq.q2: Does it need a build tool like Webpack or Vite?
faq.a2: No. Open it with any static server (even a free VS Code extension) and it runs. No npm install, no build step.
faq.q3: Can I add more languages besides English and Arabic?
faq.a3: Yes — the translation system is JSON-based and documented in /docs. Adding a language is copying one file and translating the values.
faq.q4: Can I use this for a client project?
faq.a4: Yes, personal and client work are covered by the license included with your purchase — check the license file for the exact terms before reselling or redistributing the template itself.
